input: This Lease is made between Westbrook Leasing Limited as Landlord and Halvers Bicycle Repair Ltd as Tenant for the premises at Unit 3, 27 Corvane Industrial Way, Port Alder. The Term is 36 months beginning on the Commencement Date. Either party may end this Lease at the expiry of the Term by giving the other not less than 90 days written notice. If no such notice is served, the Lease renews automatically for a further period of 12 months on the same terms, and continues to do so at the end of each further period.

The Landlord, Westbrook Leasing Limited, lets to Pemberly Dental Studio LLP the ground floor suite at 9 Larkspur Row, Marrowgate, for a Term of 24 months. The Tenant may request a renewal by serving written notice on the Landlord at least 60 days before the Term ends; any renewal takes effect only when both parties sign a new lease. Nothing in this clause obliges the Landlord to grant a renewal, and the Lease does not continue after the Term unless a new lease has been signed.

Westbrook Leasing Limited grants to Ostrander Tile & Stone Ltd a lease of the yard and workshop at 14 Fenwick Sidings, Port Alder, for a fixed Term of 18 months. This Lease is not renewable: it expires on the last day of the Term without the need for notice from either party, and the Tenant must deliver vacant possession on that day. The Tenant shall confirm its vacating arrangements to the Landlord in writing not less than 30 days before the Term ends.

Tenant: Quillon Analytics Ltd. Premises: fourth floor, Thistlewood House, 41 Thistlewood Parade, Marrowgate. Landlord: Westbrook Leasing Limited. Term: 60 months from the Commencement Date. Renewal: this Lease renews automatically for successive periods of 60 months unless either party serves written notice of non-renewal on the other. Notice: any notice of non-renewal must be served at least 180 days before the end of the then current period, failing which the Lease renews for the next period on the terms then in force, subject only to the rent review in clause 6.

By this Lease Westbrook Leasing Limited lets the kiosk unit at 2 Old Tannery Yard, Kelsworth, to Marigold Bakehouse Ltd for a Term of 12 months. The parties agree that the Term is a single fixed period with no renewal; on its expiry the Tenant's right to occupy ends and the Landlord may re-let the kiosk without further notice. The Tenant must give the Landlord 45 days written notice of the date on which its fittings will be removed so that the handover inspection can be arranged.

Westbrook Leasing Limited (the Landlord) lets to Tarrow & Finch Solicitors LLP (the Tenant) the second and third floors of 88 Brackenhill Road, Dunnery Cross, for a Term of 120 months. The Tenant has a right to renew for one further term on the same terms, exercisable by serving a written renewal request on the Landlord not less than 270 days before the Term expires. A renewal is effective only once a renewal deed has been executed by both parties; the Lease does not renew of its own accord.

This clause sets out the term and renewal arrangements agreed between Westbrook Leasing Limited and Brightwater Physio Ltd for the treatment rooms at Unit 7, Quarry Lane Business Park, Ashby Vale. The Term is 36 months. At the end of the Term the Lease continues automatically for a further 36 months, and then for further periods of the same length, unless one party has given the other written notice of at least 120 days that it does not wish the Lease to continue. The rent for each further period is the rent payable immediately before it begins.

Landlord: Westbrook Leasing Limited. Tenant: Cobalt Fern Florists Ltd. Premises: the retail unit at 5 Miller's Walk, Stourmouth. Term: 24 months. This Lease is granted for the Term only. It confers no right of renewal and does not continue beyond the last day of the Term. The Tenant shall notify the Landlord in writing at least 30 days before the end of the Term of the date on which it will hand back the keys, and shall remove its stock and signage before that date.

Westbrook Leasing Limited lets the print hall and offices at 19 Fenwick Sidings, Port Alder, to Ridgeway Print Works Ltd for a Term of 48 months. If the Tenant wishes to renew, it must serve a written request on the Landlord no later than 90 days before the Term ends. The Landlord will consider the request in good faith and, if it agrees, the parties will sign a new lease. The Lease does not renew automatically and ends on the last day of the Term unless a new lease has been signed by then.

Westbrook Leasing Limited grants to Sable Street Records Ltd a lease of the shop at 12 Sable Street, Hensbridge, for a Term of 12 months. On expiry the Lease renews automatically for a further 12 months, and thereafter from year to year, unless either party has served on the other written notice to end it. Such notice must be given at least 30 days before the end of the Term or of any renewed period. Each renewed period is on the same terms as this Lease, including the rent set out in clause 3.

This Lease between Westbrook Leasing Limited and Northgate Veterinary Practice Ltd concerns the clinic premises at 63 Wickerton Road, Wickerton, and is for a Term of 84 months. The Tenant may apply to renew the Lease by giving the Landlord written notice at least 240 days before the Term expires. A renewal is granted only by a new lease signed by both parties and on terms to be agreed at that time. In the absence of a signed renewal the Lease ends on the expiry of the Term.

The workshop at Unit 11, Corvane Industrial Way, Port Alder, is let by Westbrook Leasing Limited to Lindqvist Joinery Ltd for a Term of 30 months. The parties record that the Landlord intends to refurbish the building after the Term, and accordingly this Lease carries no right of renewal and will not be extended. The Tenant agrees to give the Landlord at least 60 days written notice of its planned move-out date so that the refurbishment contractor can be booked.

Westbrook Leasing Limited lets Rooms 4 and 5 at Amberfield House, 30 Chapel Green, Farrowby, to Amberfield Tutoring Ltd. The Term is 24 months. Unless either party gives the other at least 60 days written notice before the Term ends, the Lease renews automatically for a further 24 months on the same terms, and this arrangement repeats at the end of each renewed term. A notice given less than 60 days before the end of a term does not prevent that renewal but takes effect at the end of the following term.

Tenant: Kestrel Point Logistics Ltd. Landlord: Westbrook Leasing Limited. Premises: the warehouse and loading bay at 4 Haulage Court, Coldharbour Green. Term: 72 months. The Term is fixed and this Lease confers no renewal right; it expires at the end of the Term and the Tenant must then yield up the Premises. The Tenant shall give the Landlord not less than 180 days written notice of its intended vacation date to allow the Landlord to market the warehouse.

This Lease is granted by Westbrook Leasing Limited to Verrano Espresso Bar Ltd over the cafe unit at 1 Station Approach, Kelsworth, for a Term of 36 months. The Tenant may ask for a renewal by written notice served at least 90 days before the end of the Term, and any renewal must be recorded in a new lease signed by both parties before the Term ends. The Landlord is not bound to agree. If no new lease is signed, this Lease ends on the last day of the Term.

Westbrook Leasing Limited lets the shop at 22 Larkspur Row, Marrowgate, to Wexley Optical Ltd for a Term of three years from the Commencement Date. At the end of the Term this Lease renews automatically for a further three years, and so on at the end of each renewed term, unless either party has served written notice on the other, not less than 90 days before the relevant expiry date, that the Lease is to end. Each renewed term is on the terms of this Lease.

The Landlord, Westbrook Leasing Limited, grants to Dunmore Climbing Gym Ltd a lease of the former warehouse at 8 Haulage Court, Coldharbour Green, for a Term of 60 months. The Tenant may request a renewal by serving written notice on the Landlord at least six weeks before the Term ends. A renewal takes effect only when the parties have signed a new lease; the Landlord may decline, and this Lease does not continue automatically beyond the Term.

Tenant: Pallister Architects LLP. Landlord: Westbrook Leasing Limited. Premises: the studio on the top floor of 17 Brackenhill Road, Dunnery Cross. Term: two years. This Lease is for the Term only, confers no right to renew and does not continue after the Term. The Tenant must give the Landlord at least eight weeks written notice of the day on which it will hand back the studio so that the dilapidations inspection can be carried out before the Term ends.

Westbrook Leasing Limited lets to Greyhaven Games Studio Ltd the open-plan office at Suite 210, Thistlewood House, 41 Thistlewood Parade, Marrowgate, for a Term of four years. Unless one party gives the other written notice of at least four weeks before the Term ends, the Lease renews automatically for a further four years on the same terms, and the same applies at the end of each renewed term. Rent for a renewed term is reviewed under clause 6 before it begins.

This Lease is made between Westbrook Leasing Limited and Ivory Lane Nail Bar Ltd for the salon unit at 3 Ivory Lane, Stourmouth. The Term is one year. The Tenant may apply for a renewal by written notice served on the Landlord no later than two weeks before the Term ends; the Landlord will respond within ten days and any renewal is granted only by a new lease signed by both parties. Without a signed renewal the Lease ends on the expiry of the Term.

Westbrook Leasing Limited (Landlord) lets the first floor of 50 Wickerton Road, Wickerton, to Thornbury Accountancy LLP (Tenant) for a Term of ten years. The Tenant has an option to renew for a further term on the same terms, exercisable by written request served on the Landlord at least 270 days before the Term expires. The option is exercised only when a renewal deed is executed by both parties; the Lease does not continue of its own accord.

Westbrook Leasing Limited grants to Corran Bike Couriers Ltd a short lease of the lock-up at Arch 6, Fenwick Sidings, Port Alder, for a Term of six months. The Term is fixed. This Lease is not renewable and expires on the last day of the Term, when the Tenant must return the keys and remove its bicycles and racking. The Tenant agrees to give the Landlord three weeks written notice of the date on which it will clear the arch.

The kiln room and shop at 7 Old Tannery Yard, Kelsworth, are let by Westbrook Leasing Limited to Selwood Pottery Collective CIC for a Term of a year and a half. On expiry the Lease renews automatically for a further period of the same length, and again at the end of each further period, unless either party has given the other at least six weeks written notice that it wishes the Lease to end. Renewed periods are on the same terms as this Lease.

Westbrook Leasing Limited lets the bookshop at 15 Chapel Green, Farrowby, to Fable & Moss Bookshop Ltd for a Term of two years. If the Tenant wishes to renew it must serve a written renewal request on the Landlord not less than 60 days before the end of the Term. The Landlord will consider the request and, if it agrees, the parties will sign a new lease. This Lease does not renew automatically and ends on the last day of the Term if no new lease has been signed.

Tenant: Harrowgate Bridal Ltd. Landlord: Westbrook Leasing Limited. Premises: the double-fronted shop at 28 Miller's Walk, Stourmouth. Term: three years from the Commencement Date. The parties agree that the Lease is granted for the Term only and carries no right of renewal; it ends on the expiry of the Term without notice from either party. The Tenant shall give the Landlord ten weeks written notice of the date on which it will remove its fittings so that the reinstatement inspection can be arranged.

Westbrook Leasing Limited lets the nursery building at 2 Oakhurst Close, Ashby Vale, to Oakhurst Childcare Ltd for a Term of five years. At the end of the Term the Lease renews automatically for a further five years on the same terms, and continues to renew at the end of each renewed term, unless one party has served on the other, at least 120 days before the relevant expiry date, written notice that it does not wish the Lease to renew.

This Lease is granted by Westbrook Leasing Limited to Beacon Ridge Brewing Ltd over the brewhouse and taproom at Unit 2, Quarry Lane Business Park, Ashby Vale, for a Term of eight years. The Tenant may ask to renew by written notice served on the Landlord at least twelve weeks before the Term ends. Any renewal must be recorded in a new lease signed by both parties before the Term expires; otherwise the Lease ends on the last day of the Term.

Westbrook Leasing Limited grants to Tillman Upholstery Ltd a lease of the workshop at Unit 9, Corvane Industrial Way, Port Alder, for a Term of two and a half years. The Term is a single fixed period with no renewal; on its expiry the Tenant's right to occupy ends and the Landlord may re-let the unit. The Tenant must give the Landlord at least five weeks written notice of the date on which its machinery will be removed so that the handover can be scheduled.

Westbrook Leasing Limited lets the pharmacy premises at 9 Larkfield Parade, Hensbridge, to Larkfield Pharmacy Ltd for a Term of seven years. Unless either party gives the other written notice of at least 240 days before the end of the Term, this Lease renews automatically for a further seven years on the same terms, and the same applies at the end of each renewed term. The rent for a renewed term is the rent payable immediately before it begins.

The studio at 4 Cinder Lane, Hensbridge, is let by Westbrook Leasing Limited to Cinder Lane Tattoo Ltd for a Term of twelve months. The Tenant may apply for a renewal by serving written notice on the Landlord not less than four weeks before the Term ends. A renewal is granted only by a new lease signed by both parties, and the Landlord is not obliged to agree. If no new lease is signed the Lease ends on the last day of the Term.

The Tenant named in the Particulars (the Particulars name Marchbank Recruitment Ltd) takes the offices at Suite 4, 88 Brackenhill Road, Dunnery Cross, from Westbrook Leasing Limited for the Term stated in the Particulars, being 36 months. This Lease renews automatically at the end of the Term for a further period equal to the Term, and at the end of each further period, unless either party serves notice of non-renewal within the notice period in clause 4 (thirty days before the relevant expiry date).

Westbrook Leasing Limited lets the first-floor studio at 11 Chapel Green, Farrowby, to Silverline Yoga Studio Ltd for the Initial Term. Schedule 1 defines the Initial Term as a period of two years from the Commencement Date. Renewal is on the Renewal Basis set out in Schedule 1, which provides that the Tenant may request a further term by written notice and that any renewal takes effect only when both parties sign a new lease. The written notice must be served within the Notice Period, defined in Schedule 1 as 60 days before the Initial Term ends.

This Lease between Westbrook Leasing Limited and the Tenant identified in clause 1.2 (Peverell Motor Trimmers Ltd) is for the unit at Arch 9, Fenwick Sidings, Port Alder. The Term is the period stated in clause 1.4, which is 18 months. The Lease is granted for the Term only and carries no renewal right; it ends on the expiry of the Term. The Tenant shall notify the Landlord of its vacating date within the period prescribed by clause 9.3, namely six weeks before the Term ends.

Landlord: Westbrook Leasing Limited. Tenant: the company named in the Particulars, which name Hollis & Crane Estate Agents Ltd. Premises: the corner shop at 1 Miller's Walk, Stourmouth. Term: the Contractual Term defined in clause 1.1 as 60 months. Renewal: this Lease renews automatically for successive periods equal to the Contractual Term unless a party serves a non-renewal notice within the Notice Period. Clause 12.1 fixes the Notice Period at 180 days before the end of the then current period.

Westbrook Leasing Limited grants to Ashcombe Data Services Ltd a lease of the server hall at 6 Quarry Lane Business Park, Ashby Vale, for the Term. The Term is defined in the Particulars as ten years from the Commencement Date. The Tenant holds the renewal option described in Schedule 3, under which it may request a further term by written notice and a renewal is granted only by a new lease executed by both parties. Schedule 3 requires that notice to be served at least 365 days before the Term ends.

The Tenant (as defined in clause 1, where the Tenant is Bramwell Cycle Hire Ltd) takes the kiosk at Station Approach, Kelsworth, from Westbrook Leasing Limited for the Term set out in the Particulars, namely one year. Clause 8.2 applies: the Lease is not renewable, ends on the last day of the Term and confers no right to a further lease. The Tenant must give notice of its handover date within the period stated in clause 8.4, which is 30 days before the end of the Term.

Westbrook Leasing Limited lets the daylight studio at 20 Sable Street, Hensbridge, to Redfern Studio Photography Ltd. The Term is as stated in clause 2.1, being three years from the Commencement Date. Renewal follows clause 14, under which the Lease continues automatically for a further term of the same length at the end of the Term and of each further term unless a party has served a notice to end it. Clause 14.2 sets the period for that notice at 90 days before the relevant expiry.

The shop at 33 Larkspur Row, Marrowgate, is let by Westbrook Leasing Limited to the Tenant named in clause 1.3, Whitlow Tea Merchants Ltd, for the Term. Clause 1.5 states the Term as 48 months. The Tenant may apply to renew in the manner described in Schedule 2, which provides that a renewal request must be made in writing and that a renewal is effective only when a new lease is signed by both parties. Schedule 2 requires the request to be served no later than 120 days before the Term ends.

Westbrook Leasing Limited lets the third floor of Thistlewood House, 41 Thistlewood Parade, Marrowgate, to Ferndown Insurance Brokers LLP. The Term is the period defined in clause 1.1, which is five years. This Lease is subject to clause 15, which provides that the Lease is granted for the Term only, is not renewable and ends on the expiry of the Term. The Tenant must give notice of its vacating arrangements within the period in clause 15.3, which is 90 days before the end of the Term.

Tenant: the person named as Tenant in the Particulars, being Kingswell Barbers Ltd. Landlord: Westbrook Leasing Limited. Premises: the shop at 6 Cinder Lane, Hensbridge. Term: the Term stated in the Particulars, which is 24 months. This Lease renews automatically at the end of the Term for a further period equal to the Term, and so on, unless a party serves notice of non-renewal within the Notice Period. The Particulars define the Notice Period as four weeks before the relevant expiry date.

Westbrook Leasing Limited grants to the Tenant identified in the Particulars (Ellery Hardware Supplies Ltd) a lease of the trade counter and stores at 12 Haulage Court, Coldharbour Green, for the Term stated in clause 1.2, being seven years. The renewal option in Schedule 4 applies: the Tenant may request a further term by written notice and a renewal is granted only by a new lease signed by both parties. Schedule 4 requires that notice to be served at least 180 days before the Term expires.

The hall at 45 Wickerton Road, Wickerton, is let by Westbrook Leasing Limited to Moorcroft Dance Academy Ltd for the Term defined in clause 1.4, which is 30 months. Clause 11 governs expiry: the Lease is not renewable and ends on the last day of the Term without notice from either party. The Tenant shall confirm its move-out date within the period stated in clause 11.2, namely 60 days before the end of the Term.

Westbrook Leasing Limited lets the retail unit at 14 Chapel Green, Farrowby, to Pinegrove Pet Supplies Ltd for the Term. The Particulars state the Term as 36 months. Renewal is governed by clause 13, under which the Lease renews automatically for a further 36 months at the end of the Term and of each renewed term unless either party has served written notice to the contrary within the Notice Period. Clause 13.3 defines the Notice Period as 120 days before the relevant expiry date.

This Lease is between Westbrook Leasing Limited and the Tenant named in clause 1.1, Stannard Sign Makers Ltd, and concerns Unit 5, Corvane Industrial Way, Port Alder. The Term is that set out in clause 1.3, which is two years. The Tenant may seek a renewal in accordance with Schedule 2: a written request, and a renewal effective only on signature of a new lease by both parties. Schedule 2 provides that the request must be served at least 30 days before the Term ends.

Westbrook Leasing Limited lets Room 8, Amberfield House, 30 Chapel Green, Farrowby, to the Tenant named in the Particulars, Ravensworth Translation Bureau Ltd. The Term is the period stated in the Particulars, which is 12 months. Under clause 10 the Lease is granted for the Term only, carries no right of renewal and ends on the expiry of the Term. The Tenant must give notice of its handover date within the period fixed by clause 10.2, namely 45 days before the Term ends.

Westbrook Leasing Limited lets the cafe unit at 3 Station Approach, Kelsworth, to Bramble Coffee Co. Ltd for a Term of 36 months. The Tenant may request a renewal by written notice served at least 90 days before the Term ends, and a renewal ordinarily takes effect only when a new lease is signed. However, where the Tenant is a Designated Anchor Tenant under Schedule 5, this Lease instead renews automatically for a further 36 months unless a party serves notice within that same 90-day period. Schedule 5 lists Bramble Coffee Co. Ltd as a Designated Anchor Tenant.

The fifth floor of Thistlewood House, 41 Thistlewood Parade, Marrowgate, is let by Westbrook Leasing Limited to Windermount Software Ltd for a Term of 60 months. This Lease renews automatically for a further 60 months at the end of the Term unless either party gives the other at least 180 days written notice, save that where the Premises are Redevelopment Premises the Lease is not renewable and ends on the expiry of the Term. The Premises are Redevelopment Premises, having been so designated in Schedule 6 on the date of this Lease.

Westbrook Leasing Limited grants to Crayford Fitness Ltd a lease of the gym at Unit 1, Quarry Lane Business Park, Ashby Vale, for a Term of four years. At the end of the Term the Lease renews automatically for a further four years unless a party has served written notice of at least 120 days, except that if the Tenant has exercised the opt-out in clause 16 the Lease renews only by written request within that notice period and a new lease signed by both parties. The Tenant exercised the clause 16 opt-out on signing this Lease.

This Lease between Westbrook Leasing Limited and Lockhart Music Tuition Ltd for Rooms 1 to 3 at 11 Chapel Green, Farrowby, is for a Term of two years. The Lease is granted for the Term only and does not renew, unless the Tenant is a Continuing Occupier, in which case the Lease renews automatically for further two-year periods unless either party serves at least 60 days written notice before the relevant expiry. The Tenant has occupied the Rooms under earlier leases since 2019 and is a Continuing Occupier as defined in clause 1.1.

Westbrook Leasing Limited lets the delicatessen at 19 Miller's Walk, Stourmouth, to Sorrel & Sage Delicatessen Ltd for a Term of three years. This Lease renews automatically for a further three years at the end of the Term unless either party gives the other at least six weeks written notice. That automatic renewal does not apply where the Premises form part of a Managed Parade, in which case the Tenant may request a renewal within the same notice period and a renewal is granted only by a new lease signed by both parties. Miller's Walk is a Managed Parade under Schedule 2.

The basement studios at 7 Sable Street, Hensbridge, are let by Westbrook Leasing Limited to Quenby Recording Studios Ltd for a Term of 60 months. The Tenant may request a renewal by serving written notice at least 90 days before the Term ends, with any renewal to be granted by a new lease signed by both parties; but this right is excluded, and the Lease ends on the expiry of the Term without renewal, where the Landlord has served a Redevelopment Notice before the Lease is signed. The Landlord served a Redevelopment Notice on the Tenant on the day before this Lease was signed.

Westbrook Leasing Limited grants to Hartsfield Print Finishing Ltd a lease of Unit 8, Corvane Industrial Way, Port Alder, for a Term of 24 months. The Tenant may apply for a renewal by written request served at least eight weeks before the Term ends, and a renewal is ordinarily granted only by a new lease signed by both parties. This does not apply to an Estate Tenant, whose lease renews automatically for a further 24 months unless a party serves notice within that same eight-week period. The Tenant is an Estate Tenant, holding two other units on the estate from the Landlord.

The shop at 27 Larkspur Row, Marrowgate, is let by Westbrook Leasing Limited to Delacroix Framing Ltd for a Term of one year. At the end of the Term the Lease renews automatically for a further year unless either party has given the other at least 30 days written notice, except where the Tenant has given a Vacating Undertaking, in which case the Lease is not renewable and ends on the last day of the Term. The Tenant gave a Vacating Undertaking in the form set out in Schedule 3 on signing this Lease.

Westbrook Leasing Limited lets the laundrette at 5 Tenby Row, Wickerton, to Tenby Row Laundrette Ltd for a Term of 36 months. The Lease is granted for the Term only and carries no right of renewal, unless the Tenant holds an Option Certificate, in which case the Tenant may request a further term by written notice served at least 60 days before the Term ends and a renewal is granted by a new lease signed by both parties. The Landlord issued an Option Certificate to the Tenant on the Commencement Date.

This Lease between Westbrook Leasing Limited and Ironholt Strength Gym Ltd concerns the ground floor of 16 Haulage Court, Coldharbour Green, and is for a Term of 48 months. The Lease is not renewable and ends on the expiry of the Term; however, where the Tenant has paid the Renewal Premium described in Schedule 7 before the Commencement Date, the Lease instead renews automatically for a further 48 months unless either party gives at least 120 days written notice before the Term ends. The Tenant paid the Renewal Premium in full before the Commencement Date.

Westbrook Leasing Limited lets the showroom at 9 Old Tannery Yard, Kelsworth, to Aldwyn Antiques Ltd for a Term of two years. The Tenant may request a renewal by written notice served at least four weeks before the Term ends, any renewal being granted only by a new lease signed by both parties. This right does not apply where the Premises are Listed for Disposal in Schedule 1, in which case the Lease ends on the expiry of the Term and is not renewable. The Premises are Listed for Disposal in Schedule 1.

Westbrook Leasing Limited lets the second floor of 88 Brackenhill Road, Dunnery Cross, to Pollard & Vane Chartered Surveyors LLP for a Term of 60 months. This Lease renews automatically for a further 60 months at the end of the Term unless either party serves at least 180 days written notice, except that where the Tenant occupies under a Shared Services Agreement the Lease renews only on the Tenant's written request within that notice period and a new lease signed by both parties. The Tenant occupies under the Shared Services Agreement dated the same day as this Lease.

The atelier at 31 Larkspur Row, Marrowgate, is let by Westbrook Leasing Limited to Meridian Fold Tailors Ltd for a Term of three years. The Lease is granted for the Term only and does not renew, save that a Tenant who has fitted out the Premises at its own cost under an Approved Fit-Out is entitled to automatic renewal for a further three years unless a party serves at least 90 days written notice before the Term ends. The Landlord approved the Tenant's fit-out as an Approved Fit-Out under clause 7 before this Lease was signed.

Westbrook Leasing Limited grants to Greaves Watch Repairs Ltd a lease of the kiosk at 2 Station Approach, Kelsworth, for a Term of 18 months. At the end of the Term the Lease renews automatically for a further 18 months unless either party gives the other at least six weeks written notice; but where the kiosk is a Concession Unit, renewal is instead by the Tenant's written request within that notice period and a new lease signed by both parties. The kiosk is a Concession Unit, being listed as such in Schedule 4.

The glasshouses at 3 Oakhurst Close, Ashby Vale, are let by Westbrook Leasing Limited to Cloverdale Nursery Plants Ltd for a Term of five years. The Tenant may apply to renew by written notice served at least 120 days before the Term ends, and a renewal is granted by a new lease signed by both parties; this right falls away, and the Lease ends on the expiry of the Term without renewal, if the Landlord has obtained planning consent to redevelop the site before the Commencement Date. The Landlord obtained that planning consent two months before the Commencement Date.
